Questions

Why does a review of my 8,000-word paper cost about $39?

A review reads the draft several times and fetches the sources behind every checkable claim — each verified claim costs roughly 69 credits on Base and 309 on Frontier inside a Review (41 and 183 in a stand-alone Fact-check); fact-check off drops that paper from ≈3,940 to ≈1,320 credits.

What if I run out of credits?

Top-ups never expire for 12 months, and the 150-credit trial pocket is yours to spend. Nothing auto-bills — auto-reload is opt-in with your own monthly cap.

Do unused credits roll over?

Included credits roll over up to 2× your monthly amount; the excess expires at reset with a 7-day warning.

What happens after the trial?

After day 14 the account is Free: 10 credits/day for chat, expiring nightly; no runs.

Is my text used to train models?

No. Drafts, letters, and telemetry never train models, and providers are bound by the same zero-retention terms.

What's not included yet?

The Team plan is a waitlist; single sign-on, retention controls, and mobile editing are on the roadmap — everything on this page works today.
